book.name: Hen nepaka-ammu
book.title: Hen nepaka-ammu an Juanway mekaman ah tapen chi ag-agaw

content: Hen anchi ak-akettoyay libnu way iné-égnanan hen anchi anghel

Angkay narpaschi yag wacha hen kasen-o innila way anghel way ammag orhe way cha émhép way narpod uchu way nafufunnafunan ah funat ya nahohòrongan ah telag. Ya hen féharna agé, ammag kaman yanggay init, yag hen he-ena wat ammag kaman hen natotood way apoy.
Yag iné-égnanana agé hen anchi ak-akettoy way libnu way nafufùyag. Yag yachi way inémhép, nansékang way ginagattenan hen awanna hen fayfay ya hen anchi igidna hen anchi lota.
Yag annaat chakarén way man-ongaw way ammag kaman toor chi layun hen ongawna. Yag anat agé somongfat hen anchi pituy echor.

Yag yachi way narpas hen ommechoran hen anchi echor, yag chà ilugi way mangensorat koma hen anchi imfagacha. Ngém hen hiyachi agé, chengngar-o hen anchi nan-ale ad uchu way mangempawa, ekatnéén, “Achim cha esos-orat hen anchi enalen hen anchi pituy echor te achi mepaka-ammuchi.”
Yachi yag hen anchi anghel way innilà way tommatàchég hen anchi fayfay ya hen lota, entànangna hen awanay limana ad uchu

way nangensapata way narpon Apudyus paat hen ifagana way ah Apudyus, hiya hen anchi natattagu ah ing-inggana ya hiya hen nangamma ad uchu ya hen lota ya umat agé hen fayfay ya hen egachay ininggaw an cha nadchi. Yag ensapatan hen anchi anghel way mangaliyén, “Maid kasen hahadchén, te achi miyaw-awni hen ka-ammaana,

te no umchah hen manangguyufan hen anchi ma-apituy anghel, wat yachi hen mangammaan Apudyus hen anchi cha-an ma-ammuwan way planona way imfafaggana chillu hen anchichay profeta way nansérfi an hiya ad namenghan.”

Yachi yag kasen nan-ale hen anchi chan ale ad uchu, yag imfagana an haén way mangaliyén, “In-a ta im aran hen anchi ak-akettoy way libnu way nafufùyag way iné-égnanan hen anchi anghel way gummagaten hen fayfay ya hen lota.”
Wat émméyà hen anchi anghel way i mangimfaga hen anchi libnu, yag annaat ekat an haénén, “Anto, aram yag enanno. Yag awniyat umis ah fagangno way kaman yanggay chilu, ngém pomaket no éméy ah potom.”
Wat enawat-o hen anchi libnu hen anchi anghel yag enan-o. Yag tot-owa way ammag umis ah fagang-o way kaman chilu. Ngém angkay inùmun-o, ammag pommaket ah potò.

Yachi yag wacha hen nangimfaga an haén way mangaliyén, “Masapor chillu way etoroyno way mangempagngar hen imfagan Apudyus way mekaman hen egachay kapo-opo-on chi tagu ah karotarota ya katoratoray ya kafabréfabréy ya hen aminay narpon egachay karase way ale.”
